name: impervious hide
description: Bullets flatten against skin like hail on a car.

name: the angrier he gets...
description: Every wound makes him stronger, to a point.

name: tireless
description: Physical exertion costs a fifth of the usual stamina.

name: high pain threshold
description: Half the pain and shock penalties, +3 to resist knockdown and agony.

name: gun fu
description: Draws, shoots and moves in one motion.

name: super speed
description: Lives eight seconds for every one of yours: acts, reacts and recovers 8x as fast, and hits with the momentum of it (ST x tempo^0.35 for muscle-powered attacks: about ST x 2 at tempo 8).

name: night-vision goggles
description: Sees in the dark almost as well as in daylight.
